about_the_game:
Get ready for a hilarious and unpredictable adventure where nothing is as it seems! In this wacky puzzle game, you’ll be thrown into a series of brain-teasing challenges that will test your logic, creativity, and sense of humor. Each level presents a new, absurd situation—often completely illogical and always unexpected.

Your main goal? To troll and outwit some of the most famous football players in the world. Whether you're pulling pranks, solving bizarre puzzles, or turning the rules of reality upside down, each level offers laugh-out-loud moments and clever twists. Expect impossible scenarios, absurd logic, and plenty of surprises that will keep you guessing (and laughing) from start to finish.

If you love games that break the rules and make you think outside the box, this over-the-top football-themed comedy adventure is the perfect challenge. Can you solve every puzzle and troll them all?

Controls:

Mouse left button (click, hold, swipe)
